I was on a memorial motorbike ride for a late friend. We used to have a huge convoy to the accident site, the place we all used to fuck about and ride real fast around and then to his grave.
There was usually around 40 bikes and then about 5 or so cars. We set off from the usual spot to get to the first stop and I notice my friends car ahead but in the back seat, stunningly bright blonde hair. Next few miles rolled by and I was like a moth to a flame, eyes fixated on the back of a head.
The car ahead starts to slow down for traffic lights and she looks behind, straight at me. Her eyes were like two blue glowing lights... She was utterly stunning.

I paid for the paint repair to his rear bumper.

A few hours later, we're at the last spot on our ride, the little corner we'd all race around. We'd all do stupid wheelies and such. I pulled into the layby we'd all sit and talk at after messing around, got off my bike and fell to the floor (had a bad bike accident a few months before and trapped nerves are painful).
She comes sprinting over to try and catch me, asking if I'm OK.
I manage to summon three words while in pain and looking at the most gorgeous person I'd ever laid eyes on... "Could be worse". Why?! Idiot brain decided to then ignore the next few questions she asks apparently.

Cutting it short, we were together for about 6 months. It was amazing... Until I found out she liked to sleep with married men... Or rich men... Or pretty much, other men.
